question: In evidence.zip, Use the unique d27-- member whose basename ends d27_tcc.elf. Name the C library the image is built against (PT_INTERP / DT_NEEDED, or the static libc banner). Submit exactly one listed lowercase token.
generator_cmd: sh ta_gen.sh  # gcc -g | clang-18 -g -no-pie | gcc -static -s | aarch64-linux-gnu-gcc -g -static | zig cc -target x86_64-linux-musl | gcc + strip -s -R .comment; ta_d27_{gcc,tcc}.elf = D27 GM members verbatim
oracle_cmd: sh -c 'l=$(readelf -lW ta_d27_tcc.elf | grep -o "interpreter: [^]]*"); d=$(readelf -d ta_d27_tcc.elf | grep NEEDED); case "$l$d" in *musl*) echo musl;; *ld-linux*|*libc.so.6*) echo glibc;; *system/bin/linker*) echo bionic;; *) if strings -a ta_d27_tcc.elf | grep -qE "GNU C Library|Fatal glibc error"; then echo glibc; elif strings -a ta_d27_tcc.elf | grep -qx __init_libc; then echo musl; else echo none; fi;; esac'
